title: Auditing an LLM Judge for Competency Question Coverage: Verbatim Quotes Are Not Support
description:
Replication package for the IEEE Access manuscript Auditing an LLM Judge for Competency Question Coverage: Verbatim Quotes Are Not Support.

Contents: the competency-question bank with groundings and deterministic SPARQL ASK queries; the frozen Brick Schema v1.4.4 snapshot (BSD-3-Clause, upstream licence included); the Layer-1/Layer-2 rubric and rendering specification; the scoring and analysis harness with its tests; the per-cell judge results; the locked AH-pass labels and the registered analyses (rater-safe and unsealed outputs); the redacted public copy of the pre-registration (PREREG addenda 1–14) with a redaction log, and the later addenda (16–18 and 21–31) as separate scrubbed files; the review-round analyses (plans, scripts, per-call records, results); the manuscript and its supplement.

Provenance of the data. Judge outputs, the auxiliary labels and the AI drafts are AI-generated. The locked labels are LLM-assisted (AI-drafted, author-revised) labels from a single rater who is the author, not independent human labels; every statistic computed from them is exploratory. No washout re-score and no second annotation by a non-author was conducted; the second rater's labels come from a member of the author team.

Licences: code MIT; data and documents CC BY 4.0; the Brick snapshot and Brick-derived files keep the upstream BSD-3-Clause licence.
